entry.title: design: the link card names the language
entry.content:
design: the link card names the language

At 300px in a message bubble only the headline survives, and "Read a page. Then talk about it."
fits a book club as well as a reader for learners. The headline is now "Read a page of French.
Then talk about it." with French on the reader's saved-word marker (#FFD8A8, the landing's .mark),
88px in four lines; cover, press and URL line unchanged. og:title becomes "Sotto, learn a language
by reading" so the caption under the image widens it past French; the descriptions name French,
Spanish, Italian, Portuguese and more; the image URL bumps to ?v=3 so cached previews refresh.
og-card.mjs takes a variant name (french-page ships; french-short and generic render as alternates)
and reports the headline and marker geometry. Spec in planning/design/OG-CARD-V2-SPEC.md.

entry.title: voice: the paid origin's mid-session recovery panels never offer a pe…
entry.content:
voice: the paid origin's mid-session recovery panels never offer a personal key

recoveryPanelFor still handed the `settings` button (Use your own OpenAI key)
to two cases regardless of origin: quota_exceeded and mic_unavailable. With
cloud.enabled the panel now sends

- quota_exceeded to Plan & usage (/usage), where the reset date and the
  higher plans live, under its own copy: a subscriber has tutor minutes,
  not an OpenAI account
- mic_unavailable to Try again; the message and hint already point at the
  browser's mic permission

The free build keeps every button it had. Remaining instance from the
2026-09-08 sweep (55347de), found by the worker who made that change.
495 client tests, tsc and prettier clean.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>

entry.title: paid flow: land a new subscriber in the app, and never offer a person…
entry.content:
paid flow: land a new subscriber in the app, and never offer a personal key on the paid origin

- paywall: Stripe checkout opens in the same tab on web; it opened a second tab
  and the first sat on Subscribe
- account: a return from Stripe shows You're in / Your tutor is on / Start reading
  above the settings list; a signed-in visitor carrying returnTo is sent there
  instead of to settings
- voice: the paid build's recovery panels drop Use your own OpenAI key; a failed
  /me reads as unreachable rather than signed out, with its own message; the free
  build's tutor panel links a subscriber back to app.readsotto.app

Traced 2026-09-08 after a new subscriber paid and could not find the tutor.
493 client tests, tsc clean.
